sources.note: Main project page. Describes OpenEMR as most popular open-source EHR/practice management solution. Lists core features: scheduling, e-prescribing, billing, labs, clinical decision rules, multilingual support. Mentions Peace Corps, IPPF as notable users.

ONC certification details for versions 7.0 and 8. Lists certified criteria, CQMs, required third-party service (EMR Direct phimail ~$300 setup + $150/yr). Version 7.0 retiring Feb 2026. SVAP updates to USCDI v5.

Comprehensive feature list. Covers clinical records, scheduling, prescriptions, billing (CPT/HCPCS/ICD/SNOMED), patient portal, forms, reporting, DICOM viewer, eye care module, group therapy, multilingual support, access controls.
Patient portal features: view demographics/conditions/meds/labs, schedule appointments, secure messaging and chat, online payments, document center for forms, CCR/CCD downloads, e-signatures.

Database schema documentation. Tables organized by function: patient_data, form_encounter, forms, billing, claims, ar_activity, insurance_data, lists (problems/meds/allergies), pnotes, prescriptions, procedures, calendar, users, gacl_*, globals.
Technical architecture: PHP/Apache/MySQL(MariaDB), InnoDB engine, phpGACL access control, LDAP support, session management for concurrent windows.

4.2/5 stars (31 reviews). Users praise cost, customization, data ownership. Cons: requires IT expertise, billing module limitations, steep learning curve. Used by small practices (1-10 staff), some specialty practices.

3.9/5 overall (21 reviews), 4.4/5 value for money. Pros: low cost, fast UI, customizable, integrated billing. Cons: setup complexity, community support delays, requires consultants for advanced config.
Third-party guide covering features, FHIR API, billing/coding (ICD-10, CPT), e-prescribing, telehealth, Bootstrap 5 UI modernization, hybrid-cloud deployment.
Peace Corps adopted OpenEMR via five-year contract with EnSoftek for deployment in 77 countries. Confirms global reach and institutional adoption.
Add-on modules marketplace: Telehealth (Comlink, ~$16/mo), Fax/SMS (etherFAX/RingCentral/Twilio), Claims Clearinghouse (ClaimRev), Payment Processing, Prior Authorization.
ClaimRev clearinghouse module details for electronic claim submission.
Searched but 403 blocked. Key facts obtained from search snippets: Founded 2001, GPL release 2002, 20,000+ facilities in 184 countries, 90M+ patients, OEMR nonprofit 2010, OpenEMR Foundation 2019.
